I would also note that RTP is kind of a generic computer term. As it's used in the forums, it means the engine's default resources, but it may have other meanings outside the forums.
Anything in this thread or forums which is based on the RTP is free to use with the MV engine. Everything requires credit to Kadokawa. Some of the edits also require you to credit a forum user. (Each link should list terms and conditions).

posts.author: Parallax Panda
posts.body:
This list is very cool, efforts such as this is what makes this community awesome.
Question though. I noticed that you linked to the Japanese site tkool.jp which I
think
is Kadokawa's main site? Well regardless, there are some additional material released there, most interestingly
this
pack which looks like a celebration release for reaching 1.000.000 sales for the engine(?). It contains lots of sprites for many of the SF-RTP battler. Really, really nice stuff.
Now, I'll assume it's released by Kadokawa and that it's free to use (even for commercial games), as long as you own and use it in MV of course. But that's only an assumption based on the belief that the site and the resources in question belongs to, and have been release by Kadokawa respectively. As well as my (not perfect) translation of this statement on that download page:
■『RPGツクールMV』及び他ツクールシリーズ以外への転用は禁止いたします。
■本素材は、ユーザー登録をすることなく、ユーザーが任意で加工・改変するほか、加工・改変した本素材を無償で配布することが可能です。
ただし、『RPGツクールMV』で本素材を使用のうえ制作したゲームを配信する場合には、『RPGツクールMV』のユーザー登録が必要です。
■加工・改変した本素材の販売および本素材そのままを二次配布することは禁止いたします。
Click to expand...
However, I can't go on an assumption alone when fact is that I can't read at a native level - which means I can't be sure. Also, as far as I do understand what's written, it doesn't seem to specifically say anything about what additional credits (if any?) that would be required. When it comes to legal stuff, the devil is always in the details, and I'm also unsure about the details of distribution mentioned. Is it fine to use and distribute (and sell as part of a game)? It doesn't seem to say anything about encryption though so is that maybe not needed? So many questions.
I want to be really, really sure since I might be tempted at using some of those sprites for a game that I might end up selling. Which would mean re-distributing them as part of a commercial product.

Oh wow, good catch. I'm gonna *guess* that them using those characters was probably an oversite or something. But technically, I think that the TOU (translated by Chrome) on the download page is saying that they're fair game:
Sailing ship map project data usage conditions​
Code:
These terms of use (hereinafter referred to as "Terms of Use") are the use of Gotcha Gotcha Games Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "our company") and "Race Game Kit Project Data" (hereinafter referred to as "Project Data"). It shall apply to all relationships with a person (hereinafter referred to as "user"). Users should read these Terms of Use before downloading the project data. You are deemed to have agreed to these Terms of Use when you begin downloading the project data.
  (1) The user can use this material (project data) for free.
  (2) It is prohibited to divert this material (project data) to anything other than "RPG Maker MV" and other Maker series.
  (3) This material (project data) can be arbitrarily processed, modified and used by the user in "RPG Maker MV" without registering as a user of "RPG Maker MV", and this material processed and modified by the user. It is possible to distribute games including the game free of charge. However, if you want to distribute a game created using this material with "RPG Maker MV", you need to register as a user of "RPG Maker MV". Similarly, if you want to distribute a game created using this material in another Maker series, you need to register as a user of the Maker series used in the production.
  (4) It is prohibited to sell the processed / modified material (project data) or to distribute the material (project data) as it is, regardless of whether it is paid or free of charge.
  (5) All rights, including copyrights, neighboring rights, and other intellectual property rights related to project data, belong to the Company and third parties recognized by the Company.
As far as I'm concerned, those faces and character images are definitely part of the "project data", so it's probably safe for people to use them. However, there aren't any SV actor images or character busts, so it's good that you and I already own the DLC anyway.
